issue_context.title: Type.GetInterfaceMap is not annotated for trimming
issue_context.body:
I think illink will already make sure we don't trim the interface type from the interface list, but illink might still consider the inteface methods to be a fair game. To prevent behavioral differences I think we need to annotate the `ifaceType` parameter as requiring all public methods.

This was flagged by the analysis in NativeAOT since the NativeAOT implementation of this API is done with regular C#.
